title: An Asia defense ETF is down 15%, H World rose 8.9% today, and onemacro fund has a +15% target
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
International ETFs and overseas names moved for different reasons  
today. An Asia defense ETF is down about 15%, H World Group rose about  
8.9% in the session, and one macro fund has a target implying about  
15% upside, per today's write-ups.  
  
Here is a look at the group. Price targets are targets, not promises.  
  
\*\*1. WisdomTree Asia Defense Fund (WDAF)\*\* — WDAF declined roughly 15%  
over the last 30 days, extending a multi-month pullback from its April  
2026 peak. Over the last quarter, the fund fell approximately 26% ,  
reflecting sustained selling pressure across Asian defense and  
aerospace equities.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/wisdomtree-asia-defense-fund-wdaf-drops-15-over-30-days-in-extended-asian-defense-pullback-39054/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/wisdomtree-asia-defense-fund-wdaf-drops-15-over-30-days-in-extended-asian-defense-pullback-39054/)  
  
\*\*2. H World Group (HTHT)\*\* — HTHT jumped +8.87%, rising to $54.86  
from Friday's $50.39 close, a +$4.47 move recorded during Monday's  
regular session rather than premarket or after-hours. The catalyst was  
the pre-market Q3 2026 report: earnings of ¥6.23 per ADS beat the  
¥5.41 consensus, revenue of ¥7.75B topped the ¥7.32B estimate, and  
full-year 2026 revenue growth guidance was raised to 9%–10% from  
4%–8%.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-h-world-group-limited-htht-stock-up-8-87-today-39147/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-h-world-group-limited-htht-stock-up-8-87-today-39147/)  
  
\*\*3. Virtus AlphaSimplex Global Macro ETF (ASGM)\*\* — The central  
target of $36 is drawn from public technical and AI-based price  
forecasts, not from analyst price targets, which generally do not  
exist for ETFs. Target, not a promise.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/virtus-alphasimplex-global-macro-etf-asgm-assessing-the-path-to-15-gains-toward-36-38525/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/virtus-alphasimplex-global-macro-etf-asgm-assessing-the-path-to-15-gains-toward-36-38525/)  
  
\*\*4.\*\* ECON: The central target of $38 is drawn from public technical  
discussion, not an analyst consensus — ECON is an ETF and lacks  
individual analyst price targets. Target, not a promise.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/econ-etf-could-it-deliver-a-19-rally-back-to-38-38520/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/econ-etf-could-it-deliver-a-19-rally-back-to-38-38520/)  
  
\*\*5.\*\* SFTX: Horizon International Managed Risk ETF for Global  
Exposure with Built-In Protections. Business model, catalysts and  
risks inside.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/sftx-horizon-international-managed-risk-etf-for-global-exposure-with-built-in-protections-38657/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/sftx-horizon-international-managed-risk-etf-for-global-exposure-with-built-in-protections-38657/)  
  
\*\*6.\*\* IDVO: International Dividend Exposure with a Covered Call  
Income Overlay. Business model, catalysts and risks inside.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/idvo-international-dividend-exposure-with-a-covered-call-income-overlay-38607/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/idvo-international-dividend-exposure-with-a-covered-call-income-overlay-38607/)
